import sys
from itertools import permutations


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    t = [[int(data[1 + i * n + j]) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    best = None
    for order in permutations(range(1, n)):
        cost = 0
        prev = 0
        for p in order:
            cost += t[prev][p]
            prev = p
        if best is None or cost < best:
            best = cost
    print(best)


main()
